A clean game-asset sprite sheet of exactly EIGHT garage workshop props arranged in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, eight equal cells, evenly spaced, each prop centered in its own cell with an even margin, nothing touching the cell edges.

Top row left to right: 1) a steel two-post vehicle car lift platform, 2) a red mechanic tool cart with drawers and a few tools laid on top, 3) a neat stack of three black car tyres, 4) a blue industrial oil drum barrel.
Bottom row left to right: 5) a wooden workbench with a vice and scattered hand tools, 6) an orange engine hoist crane with a hanging chain, 7) a grey metal parts shelving rack stacked with boxes and car parts, 8) a tall red steel tool cabinet with drawers.

Consistent soft studio lighting from the upper left. Muted but clean colours with a hint of lime green and steel grey.

BACKGROUND: completely flat pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no gradient, no vignette, no floor, no cast shadow beneath the props.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no borders, no grid lines, no watermarks, no scenery.

A character walk-cycle sprite sheet of exactly TWELVE frames of the SAME character, arranged in a strict 3-column by 4-row grid, twelve equal cells, evenly spaced, each full-body figure centered in its own cell with an even margin.

STYLE: soft-shaded 3D render, gentle ambient occlusion, clean rounded shapes, consistent soft studio lighting from the upper left.
